description: Returns published questions and answers, optionally filtered by topic. Use it for specific questions about pricing, governance, implementation or the products. It does not search the long-form guides; use search_knowledge_base for that. To check readiness, use assess_ai_readiness.

topic.description: Optional filter. Use a category for reliable results: "assessment", "implementation", "governance", "measurement", "concepts", "pricing", or "products". Any other value falls back to a free-text search over the questions and answers (e.g. "shadow AI", "refund"), which may return nothing. Omit to get all items.

name: get_faq
title: FAQ
